## --------------------------------------------
## Frontend Server Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Frontend runs on port 8081 (backend is on 8080, so they don't clash)
#server.port=8081
#
## Application name
#spring.application.name=book-inventory-frontend
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Backend API Base URL
## --------------------------------------------
#
## This is the address of your backend machine.
## Right now both are on localhost, so it's localhost:8080.
## When you move to different machines, just change this ONE line.
## Example: backend.api.base-url=http://192.168.1.105:8080
#backend.api.base-url=http://localhost:8080
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Thymeleaf Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## During development: set to false so changes to HTML reflect immediately
## (without restarting the server)
#spring.thymeleaf.cache=false
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Session Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## We store the JWT token in the HTTP session after login.
## Session timeout: 30 minutes of inactivity
#server.servlet.session.timeout=30m
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Logging (optional but helpful during development)
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Shows what RestClient is sending/receiving in console
#logging.level.org.springframework.web.client=DEBUG
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Spring Security Session Fix
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Prevents Spring Security from redirecting to /login
## when it can't find a UserDetailsService for form processing
## (since we handle login manually in AuthViewController)
#spring.security.user.name=disabled
#spring.security.user.password=disabled
#
## Session cookie settings
#server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true
#server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=strict



# ========================
# SERVER
# ========================
server.port=8081
spring.application.name=book-inventory-frontend

# ========================
# BACKEND CONNECTION
# ========================
backend.base-url=http://localhost:8080

# ========================
# THYMELEAF
# ========================
spring.thymeleaf.cache=false

# ========================
# LOGGING
# ========================
logging.level.org.springframework=INFO
logging.level.com.bookinventoryfrontend=DEBUG

<script>
// Theme Initialization
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
  }
});

// Theme Toggle Function
function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}
</script>

</body>

<script>
// IMPORTANT: Update this variable to match your Backend Server URL!
const BACKEND_URL = 'http://localhost:8080';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Dark mode'; 
  } else {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Light mode';
  }
});

function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
  if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = isDark ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode';
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}

function switchTab(id, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + id).classList.add('active');
  el.classList.add('active');
}

function toggle(card) {
  card.classList.toggle('open');
}

// Write Operations trigger API calls and then redirect to the UI!
function doUpdate() {
  const id = document.getElementById('w-upd-id').value;
  if (!id) { alert('Please enter an Author ID'); return; }
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/authors/' + id, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ firstName: 'Updated', lastName: 'Author', photo: '' })
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(() => { 
      // Redirect to the Author Profile UI upon success
      window.location.href = '/authors/' + id; 
  })
  .catch(() => alert('Request sent (check network tab for response)'));
}

function doDelete() {
  const id = document.getElementById('w-del-id').value;
  if (!id) { alert('Please enter an Author ID'); return; }
  if (!confirm('Delete author ' + id + '? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/authors/' + id, { method: 'DELETE' })
    .then(() => {
        alert('Author deleted successfully');
        // Redirect back to Authors List UI upon success
        window.location.href = '/authors';
    })
    .catch(() => alert('Delete request sent'));
}

function doDeleteBA() {
  const isbn = document.getElementById('w-del-isbn').value;
  const aid  = document.getElementById('w-del-aid').value;
  if (!isbn || !aid) { alert('Please fill in both ISBN and Author ID'); return; }
  if (!confirm('Remove book-author mapping? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/book-authors/' + isbn + '/' + aid, { method: 'DELETE' })
    .then(() => alert('Mapping removed successfully'))
    .catch(() => alert('Delete request sent'));
}
</script>

</body>
</html>

                      style="font-weight:600;">
                </span>
                <span th:if="${mapping.get('author') == null}" style="color:var(--text3);font-style:italic;font-size:12px;">
                  Name not provided by API
                </span>
              </td>
              
              <td>
                <span th:if="${mapping.get('primaryAuthor') == 'Y'}" class="badge-primary">Primary Author</span>
                <span th:if="${mapping.get('primaryAuthor') == 'N'}" style="color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;">Co-Author</span>
              </td>
              
              <td>
                <div class="action-cell">
                  <a th:href="@{/store-owner/book-authors/{isbn}/{id}/edit(isbn=${isbn}, id=${mapping.get('authorId') ?: mapping.get('authorID')})}" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline">Edit Role</a>
                  
                  <form th:action="@{/store-owner/book-authors/{isbn}/{id}/delete(isbn=${isbn}, id=${mapping.get('authorId') ?: mapping.get('authorID')})}" method="post" style="display:inline;" onsubmit="return confirm('Remove this author from the book?');">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger">Remove</button>
                  </form>
                </div>
              </td>

            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <div th:if="${bookAuthors == null or #lists.isEmpty(bookAuthors)}" style="padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--text2)">
          <p>No authors assigned to this book yet.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

FILE: .\book-inventory-management-frontend\src\main\resources\templates\fragments\navbar.html
==================================================

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org"
      xmlns:sec="http://www.thymeleaf.org/extras/springsecurity6">

<!--
  NAVBAR FRAGMENT
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  WHY session checks instead of sec:authorize?
  Spring Security context can be unreliable between requests in this setup.
  The session attributes JWT_TOKEN, ROLE_NAME etc. are set directly by
  AuthViewController.processLogin() — they are always accurate.

  SESSION_JWT_TOKEN  → set after login, cleared after logout
  SESSION_ROLE_NAME  → "Admin" / "StoreOwner" / "RegisteredUser" / "Guest"
  SESSION_USER_NAME  → username string
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-->
<nav class="navbar" th:fragment="navbar">

  <!-- Brand -->
  <a class="navbar-brand" th:href="@{/home}">Book<span>Inventory</span></a>

  <!-- Nav links — only when JWT is in session (= truly logged in) -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN != null}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/home}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='home'}?'active'">Home</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/team/user-module}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='user-module'}?'active'">My APIs</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/profile}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='profile'}?'active'">Profile</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/dashboard}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='dashboard'}?'active'">Dashboard</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Store link — StoreOwner or Admin only -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.ROLE_NAME == 'StoreOwner' or session.ROLE_NAME == 'Admin'}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/store-owner/purchases}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='store'}?'active'">Store</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Admin link — Admin only -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.ROLE_NAME == 'Admin'}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/admin/users}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='admin'}?'active'">Admin</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Right-side actions -->
  <div class="navbar-right">

    <!-- NOT logged in (no JWT in session) -->
    <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN == null}">
      <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" th:href="@{/auth/login}">Login</a>
      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" th:href="@{/auth/register}">Register</a>
    </th:block>

    <!-- Logged in — show username + role + logout -->
    <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN != null}">
      <div class="nav-user-info">
        <span th:text="${session.USER_NAME}">username</span>
        <span class="role-tag" th:text="${session.ROLE_NAME}">Role</span>
      </div>

      <!--
        LOGOUT as a POST FORM — required because CSRF protection is enabled.
        A plain <a href="/auth/logout"> (GET) would be blocked by CSRF filter.
      -->
      <form th:action="@{/auth/logout}" method="post" style="display:inline;margin:0;">
        <input type="hidden" th:name="${_csrf.parameterName}" th:value="${_csrf.token}"/>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">Logout</button>
      </form>
    </th:block>

  </div>
</nav>

</html>

<script>
function sortTable(n) {
  var table, rows, switching, i, x, y, shouldSwitch, dir, switchcount = 0;
  table = document.getElementById("inventoryTable");
  switching = true;
  dir = "asc";
  while (switching) {
    switching = false;
    rows = table.rows;
    for (i = 1; i < (rows.length - 1); i++) {
      shouldSwitch = false;
      x = rows[i].getElementsByTagName("TD")[n];
      y = rows[i + 1].getElementsByTagName("TD")[n];
      if (dir == "asc") {
        if (x.innerHTML.toLowerCase() > y.innerHTML.toLowerCase()) {
          shouldSwitch = true;
          break;
        }
      } else if (dir == "desc") {
        if (x.innerHTML.toLowerCase() < y.innerHTML.toLowerCase()) {
          shouldSwitch = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (shouldSwitch) {
      rows[i].parentNode.insertBefore(rows[i + 1], rows[i]);
      switching = true;
      switchcount ++;
    } else {
      if (switchcount == 0 && dir == "asc") {
        dir = "desc";
        switching = true;
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

            <span class="endpoint-url">/api/v1/reviews/{id}/book/{isbn}</span>
            <span class="endpoint-desc">Delete a review identified by ISBN and reviewer ID</span>
            <div class="endpoint-inputs">
                <input id="b7" placeholder="ISBN">
                <input id="b8" placeholder="ID">
            </div>
            <span class="pub-tag">Public</span>
            <button class="action-btn red" onclick="go('/ui/reviews/' + val('b8') + '/delete/' + val('b7'))">DELETE</button>
        </div>

    </div>

</div><!-- end page-wrapper -->

<script>
/* ── Navigation helper ─────────────────────────────────── */
function go(url) {
    if (url.includes("undefined") || url.endsWith("/")) {
        alert("Fill required fields!");
        return;
    }
    window.location.href = url;
}
function val(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id).value;
}

/* ── Toast helpers ─────────────────────────────────────── */
let toastTimer = null;

function showToast(type, title, message) {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    const icon  = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
    const ttl   = document.getElementById('toastTitle');
    const msg   = document.getElementById('toastMsg');

    toast.classList.remove('toast-success', 'toast-error', 'show');
    icon.textContent = (type === 'success') ? '✅' : '❌';
    ttl.textContent  = title;
    msg.textContent  = message;
    toast.classList.add(type === 'success' ? 'toast-success' : 'toast-error');

    void toast.offsetWidth; // force reflow so transition re-fires
    toast.classList.add('show');

    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(closeToast, 4000);
}

function closeToast() {
    document.getElementById('toast').classList.remove('show');
    if (toastTimer) { clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = null; }
}

/* ── Read Thymeleaf flash attributes on page load ──────── */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const successMsg = document.getElementById('flashSuccess').textContent.trim();
    const errorMsg   = document.getElementById('flashError').textContent.trim();

    if (successMsg) {
        showToast('success', 'Success', successMsg);
    } else if (errorMsg) {
        showToast('error', 'Error', errorMsg);
    }
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

         CASE 1: Single reviewer object (not a list)
         ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div th:if="${data != null and !(data instanceof T(java.util.List))}">

        <!-- Deleted message -->

             class="deleted-wrap">

        <!-- Count message -->

            <div class="big-number-label">Total Reviewers</div>

        <!-- ── NEW: Generic error / not-found message ── -->
        <div th:if="${data instanceof T(java.lang.String)

                                <td th:text="${r.employedBy}"></td>
                            </tr>
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>

<script>
  async function confirmDelete() {
    const idInput = document.getElementById('deleteId');
    const id = idInput.value;
    if (!id) {
      alert('Please enter an Inventory ID.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Step 1: Check if exists by calling the detail endpoint
      // We use the absolute path or relative to context
      const response = await fetch('/store-owner/inventory/' + id, { method: 'GET' });
      
      if (response.ok && !response.url.includes('?apiError=')) {
        // Step 2: If found, ask for confirmation
        if (confirm('Item found! Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY delete record #' + id + '?')) {
          document.getElementById('deleteForm').submit();
        }
      } else {
        // Step 3: If not found (or redirected to error)
        alert('Item doesn\'t exist. No action taken.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Check failed:', error);
      alert('Unable to verify item. Please try again.');
    }
  }

  // Auto-hide success message after 5 seconds
  const alertBox = document.getElementById('successAlert');
  if (alertBox) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      alertBox.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
      alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => alertBox.remove(), 500);
    }, 5000);
  }
</script>

  <div class="api-info">
    <strong>What this API does</strong>
    Authenticates the user with username and password. Returns a signed JWT token (HS256)
    containing userId, username, and roleName as claims. Token expiry is configurable.
    Include this token as: Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt; in all subsequent protected requests.
  </div>
  <div class="card" style="padding:0;margin-bottom:16px;">
    <table class="data-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Response Field</th><th>Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>token</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>JWT Bearer token</td></tr>
        <tr><td>tokenType</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Always "Bearer"</td></tr>
        <tr><td>userId</td><td class="mono">Integer</td><td>Logged-in user's ID</td></tr>
        <tr><td>userName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Username</td></tr>
        <tr><td>firstName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>First name</td></tr>
        <tr><td>lastName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Last name</td></tr>
        <tr><td>roleName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Assigned role</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div class="alert alert-info">
    <span>i</span>
    <span>To test this endpoint live, use the
      <a th:href="@{/auth/login}" style="color:#1e40af;font-weight:600;">Login page →</a>

      <span th:with="msg=${error}"
            th:text="${#strings.contains(msg,'message') ?
                       #strings.substringBetween(msg,'&quot;message&quot;:&quot;',',&quot;') != null ?
                       #strings.substringBetween(msg,'&quot;message&quot;:&quot;',',&quot;') :
                       'The requested resource was not found. Please check the ID and try again.' :
                       msg}">
        Error message
      </span>

        </a>

## --------------------------------------------
## Frontend Server Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Frontend runs on port 8081 (backend is on 8080, so they don't clash)
#server.port=8081
#
## Application name
#spring.application.name=book-inventory-frontend
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Backend API Base URL
## --------------------------------------------
#
## This is the address of your backend machine.
## Right now both are on localhost, so it's localhost:8080.
## When you move to different machines, just change this ONE line.
## Example: backend.api.base-url=http://192.168.1.105:8080
#backend.api.base-url=http://localhost:8080
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Thymeleaf Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## During development: set to false so changes to HTML reflect immediately
## (without restarting the server)
#spring.thymeleaf.cache=false
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Session Config
## --------------------------------------------
#
## We store the JWT token in the HTTP session after login.
## Session timeout: 30 minutes of inactivity
#server.servlet.session.timeout=30m
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Logging (optional but helpful during development)
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Shows what RestClient is sending/receiving in console
#logging.level.org.springframework.web.client=DEBUG
#
## --------------------------------------------
## Spring Security Session Fix
## --------------------------------------------
#
## Prevents Spring Security from redirecting to /login
## when it can't find a UserDetailsService for form processing
## (since we handle login manually in AuthViewController)
#spring.security.user.name=disabled
#spring.security.user.password=disabled
#
## Session cookie settings
#server.servlet.session.cookie.http-only=true
#server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=strict



# ========================
# SERVER
# ========================
server.port=8081
spring.application.name=book-inventory-frontend

# ========================
# BACKEND CONNECTION
# ========================
backend.base-url=http://localhost:8080

# ========================
# THYMELEAF
# ========================
spring.thymeleaf.cache=false

# ========================
# LOGGING
# ========================
logging.level.org.springframework=INFO
logging.level.com.bookinventoryfrontend=DEBUG

<script>
// Theme Initialization
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
  }
});

// Theme Toggle Function
function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}
</script>

</body>

<script>
// IMPORTANT: Update this variable to match your Backend Server URL!
const BACKEND_URL = 'http://localhost:8080';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Dark mode'; 
  } else {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Light mode';
  }
});

function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
  if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = isDark ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode';
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}

function switchTab(id, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + id).classList.add('active');
  el.classList.add('active');
}

function toggle(card) {
  card.classList.toggle('open');
}

// Write Operations trigger API calls and then redirect to the UI!
function doUpdate() {
  const id = document.getElementById('w-upd-id').value;
  if (!id) { alert('Please enter an Author ID'); return; }
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/authors/' + id, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ firstName: 'Updated', lastName: 'Author', photo: '' })
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(() => { 
      // Redirect to the Author Profile UI upon success
      window.location.href = '/authors/' + id; 
  })
  .catch(() => alert('Request sent (check network tab for response)'));
}

function doDelete() {
  const id = document.getElementById('w-del-id').value;
  if (!id) { alert('Please enter an Author ID'); return; }
  if (!confirm('Delete author ' + id + '? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/authors/' + id, { method: 'DELETE' })
    .then(() => {
        alert('Author deleted successfully');
        // Redirect back to Authors List UI upon success
        window.location.href = '/authors';
    })
    .catch(() => alert('Delete request sent'));
}

function doDeleteBA() {
  const isbn = document.getElementById('w-del-isbn').value;
  const aid  = document.getElementById('w-del-aid').value;
  if (!isbn || !aid) { alert('Please fill in both ISBN and Author ID'); return; }
  if (!confirm('Remove book-author mapping? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  fetch(BACKEND_URL + '/api/v1/store-owner/book-authors/' + isbn + '/' + aid, { method: 'DELETE' })
    .then(() => alert('Mapping removed successfully'))
    .catch(() => alert('Delete request sent'));
}
</script>

</body>
</html>

// Check local storage so the theme persists when moving from dashboard to result page!
// Check local storage. Default to DARK unless explicitly set to 'light'
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    // User explicitly wanted light mode
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
    // For the dashboard, also update the text label
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Dark mode'; 
  } else {
    // First visit OR user explicitly wanted dark mode
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
    // For the dashboard, also update the text label
    const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
    if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = 'Light mode';
  }
});

function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  
  const darkLabel = document.getElementById('dark-label');
  if(darkLabel) darkLabel.textContent = isDark ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode';
  
  // Save preference
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}
</script>

<script>
// Standard Theme Toggle Logic
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
  const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(savedTheme === 'light') {
    document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '🌙';
  } else {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
    document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = '☀️';
  }
});

function toggleDark() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  const isDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
  document.getElementById('dark-icon').textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
  localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
}
</script>

	<h2>Books by Publisher</h2>

	<!-- Form -->
	<form action="/books/publisher" method="get">
		<label>Publisher ID:</label>
		<input type="number" name="publisherId" required>

		<label>Page:</label>
		<input type="number" name="page" value="0">

		<label>Size:</label>
		<input type="number" name="size" value="5">

		<button type="submit">Load</button>
	</form>

	<hr>

	<!-- Results -->
	<div th:if="${books != null}">

		<table border="1">
			<tr>
				<th>ISBN</th>
				<th>Title</th>
				<th>Edition</th>
			</tr>

			<tr th:each="book : ${books}">
				<td th:text="${book.isbn}"></td>
				<td th:text="${book.title}"></td>
				<td th:text="${book.edition}"></td>
			</tr>
		</table>

		<br>

		<!-- Pagination -->
		<div>
			<span th:text="'Page ' + ${currentPage} + ' of ' + ${totalPages}"></span>
		</div>

		<div>
			<a th:if="${currentPage > 0}"
				th:href="@{/books/publisher(publisherId=${publisherId}, page=${currentPage-1}, size=5)}">
				Previous
			</a>

			<a th:if="${currentPage < totalPages - 1}"
				th:href="@{/books/publisher(publisherId=${publisherId}, page=${currentPage+1}, size=5)}">
				Next
			</a>
		</div>

	</div>

</body>

  <style>
    .error-box{background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;border:1px solid #fecaca;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:16px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;}
    .success-box{background:#ecfdf5;color:#065f46;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
    .footer-actions {margin-top: 30px;padding-top: 20px;border-top: 1px solid var(--border);display: flex;justify-content: center;}
    .cart-summary { margin-top: 24px; padding: 20px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="topbar">
  <div class="logo">
    <div class="logo-title">Book Inventory API</div>
    <div class="logo-sub">My Cart</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-text">
    <h1>Shopping Cart</h1>
    <p>Review your items, select condition quality, and proceed to checkout.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="content">

  <div th:if="${apiError != null}" class="error-box" th:text="${apiError}"></div>
  <div th:if="${successMessage != null}" class="success-box" th:text="${successMessage}"></div>

  <!-- Main Checkout Form (Empty, used for association) -->
  <form id="checkoutForm" th:action="@{/user/cart/checkout}" method="post">
    <input type="hidden" name="userId" th:value="${userId}">
  </form>

  <div th:if="${userId != null and cartView != null and !#lists.isEmpty(cartView)}">
    <div class="table-wrap">
      <table class="data-table">
        <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>ISBN</th>
          <th>Book Title</th>
          <th>Select Condition</th>
          <th>Actions</th>
        </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
        <tr th:each="item : ${cartView}">
          <td th:text="${item.isbn}"></td>
          <td th:text="${item.bookTitle}"></td>
          <td>
            <div th:if="${optionsByIsbn[item.isbn] != null and !#lists.isEmpty(optionsByIsbn[item.isbn])}">
              <input type="hidden" name="isbn" th:value="${item.isbn}" form="checkoutForm"/>
              <select class="form-select" name="rank" required form="checkoutForm">
                <option value="">Choose quality...</option>
                <option th:each="opt : ${optionsByIsbn[item.isbn]}"
                        th:value="${opt.rank}"
                        th:text="${opt.condition + ' - $' + opt.price}"
                        th:disabled="${opt.availableCount <= 0}">
                </option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div th:if="${optionsByIsbn[item.isbn] == null or #lists.isEmpty(optionsByIsbn[item.isbn])}"
                 style="color:#b91c1c; font-weight:600; font-size: 13px;">
              ✖ Sold out
            </div>
          </td>
          <td>
            <div class="mini-actions">
              <form class="inline-form" th:action="@{/user/cart/remove}" method="post"
                    onsubmit="return confirm('Remove this book from your cart?');">
                <input type="hidden" name="userId" th:value="${userId}">
                <input type="hidden" name="isbn" th:value="${item.isbn}">
                <button class="btn btn-danger" type="submit">Remove</button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="cart-summary">
      <div class="summary-info">
        <p th:text="${#lists.size(cartView)} + ' items in your cart.'"></p>
      </div>
      <div class="summary-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-success" type="submit" form="checkoutForm">Proceed to Checkout</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div th:if="${userId != null and (cartView == null or #lists.isEmpty(cartView))}" class="empty-state">
    <div class="empty-icon">🛒</div>
    <h3>Your cart is empty</h3>
    <p>Please return to the dashboard to select books.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="footer-actions">
    <a class="btn btn-secondary" th:href="@{/team/inventory-module}">Back to Dashboard</a>
  </div>

</div>
</body>
</html>

FILE: .\book-inventory-management-frontend\target\classes\templates\fragments\navbar.html
==================================================

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org"
      xmlns:sec="http://www.thymeleaf.org/extras/springsecurity6">

<!--
  NAVBAR FRAGMENT
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  WHY session checks instead of sec:authorize?
  Spring Security context can be unreliable between requests in this setup.
  The session attributes JWT_TOKEN, ROLE_NAME etc. are set directly by
  AuthViewController.processLogin() — they are always accurate.

  SESSION_JWT_TOKEN  → set after login, cleared after logout
  SESSION_ROLE_NAME  → "Admin" / "StoreOwner" / "RegisteredUser" / "Guest"
  SESSION_USER_NAME  → username string
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-->
<nav class="navbar" th:fragment="navbar">

  <!-- Brand -->
  <a class="navbar-brand" th:href="@{/home}">Book<span>Inventory</span></a>

  <!-- Nav links — only when JWT is in session (= truly logged in) -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN != null}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/home}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='home'}?'active'">Home</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/team/user-module}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='user-module'}?'active'">My APIs</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/profile}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='profile'}?'active'">Profile</a>
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/dashboard}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='dashboard'}?'active'">Dashboard</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Store link — StoreOwner or Admin only -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.ROLE_NAME == 'StoreOwner' or session.ROLE_NAME == 'Admin'}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/store-owner/purchases}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='store'}?'active'">Store</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Admin link — Admin only -->
  <th:block th:if="${session.ROLE_NAME == 'Admin'}">
    <a class="nav-link" th:href="@{/user/api/admin/users}"
       th:classappend="${activePage=='admin'}?'active'">Admin</a>
  </th:block>

  <!-- Right-side actions -->
  <div class="navbar-right">

    <!-- NOT logged in (no JWT in session) -->
    <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN == null}">
      <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" th:href="@{/auth/login}">Login</a>
      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" th:href="@{/auth/register}">Register</a>
    </th:block>

    <!-- Logged in — show username + role + logout -->
    <th:block th:if="${session.JWT_TOKEN != null}">
      <div class="nav-user-info">
        <span th:text="${session.USER_NAME}">username</span>
        <span class="role-tag" th:text="${session.ROLE_NAME}">Role</span>
      </div>

      <!--
        LOGOUT as a POST FORM — required because CSRF protection is enabled.
        A plain <a href="/auth/logout"> (GET) would be blocked by CSRF filter.
      -->
      <form th:action="@{/auth/logout}" method="post" style="display:inline;margin:0;">
        <input type="hidden" th:name="${_csrf.parameterName}" th:value="${_csrf.token}"/>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">Logout</button>
      </form>
    </th:block>

  </div>
</nav>

</html>

    <table class="data-table" id="inventoryTable">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th onclick="sortTable(0)">Inventory ID <span class="sort-icon">↕</span></th>
        <th onclick="sortTable(1)">ISBN <span class="sort-icon">↕</span></th>
        <th onclick="sortTable(2)">Rank <span class="sort-icon">↕</span></th>
        <th onclick="sortTable(3)">Status <span class="sort-icon">↕</span></th>
        <th>Actions</th>
      </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
      <tr th:each="item : ${inventoryList}">
        <td th:text="${item.inventoryId}"></td>
        <td th:text="${item.isbn}"></td>
        <td th:text="${item.rank}"></td>
        <td>
          <span th:if="${item.purchased}" class="pill pill-no">SOLD</span>
          <span th:unless="${item.purchased}" class="pill pill-yes">AVAILABLE</span>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div class="mini-actions">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" th:href="@{/store-owner/inventory/edit/{id}(id=${item.inventoryId})}">Edit</a>
            <form th:action="@{/store-owner/inventory/delete/{id}(id=${item.inventoryId})}"
                  method="post"
                  onsubmit="return confirm('Permanently remove this item from inventory?');"
                  style="display:inline;">
              <button class="btn btn-danger" type="submit">Delete</button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    No inventory items found.

<script>
function sortTable(n) {
  var table, rows, switching, i, x, y, shouldSwitch, dir, switchcount = 0;
  table = document.getElementById("inventoryTable");
  switching = true;
  dir = "asc";
  while (switching) {
    switching = false;
    rows = table.rows;
    for (i = 1; i < (rows.length - 1); i++) {
      shouldSwitch = false;
      x = rows[i].getElementsByTagName("TD")[n];
      y = rows[i + 1].getElementsByTagName("TD")[n];
      if (dir == "asc") {
        if (x.innerHTML.toLowerCase() > y.innerHTML.toLowerCase()) {
          shouldSwitch = true;
          break;
        }
      } else if (dir == "desc") {
        if (x.innerHTML.toLowerCase() < y.innerHTML.toLowerCase()) {
          shouldSwitch = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (shouldSwitch) {
      rows[i].parentNode.insertBefore(rows[i + 1], rows[i]);
      switching = true;
      switchcount ++;
    } else {
      if (switchcount == 0 && dir == "asc") {
        dir = "desc";
        switching = true;
      }
    }
  }
}
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
/* ── Navigation helper ─────────────────────────────────── */
function go(url) {
    if (url.includes("undefined") || url.endsWith("/")) {
        alert("Fill required fields!");
        return;
    }
    window.location.href = url;
}
function val(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id).value;
}

/* ── Toast helpers ─────────────────────────────────────── */
let toastTimer = null;

function showToast(type, title, message) {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    const icon  = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
    const ttl   = document.getElementById('toastTitle');
    const msg   = document.getElementById('toastMsg');

    toast.classList.remove('toast-success', 'toast-error', 'show');
    icon.textContent = (type === 'success') ? '✅' : '❌';
    ttl.textContent  = title;
    msg.textContent  = message;
    toast.classList.add(type === 'success' ? 'toast-success' : 'toast-error');

    void toast.offsetWidth; // force reflow so transition re-fires
    toast.classList.add('show');

    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(closeToast, 4000);
}

function closeToast() {
    document.getElementById('toast').classList.remove('show');
    if (toastTimer) { clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = null; }
}

/* ── Read Thymeleaf flash attributes on page load ──────── */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const successMsg = document.getElementById('flashSuccess').textContent.trim();
    const errorMsg   = document.getElementById('flashError').textContent.trim();

    if (successMsg) {
        showToast('success', 'Success', successMsg);
    } else if (errorMsg) {
        showToast('error', 'Error', errorMsg);
    }
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

    <div th:if="${data != null and !(data instanceof T(java.util.List))}">

             class="deleted-wrap">

                            <td th:text="${data.employedBy}"></td>
                        </tr>

            </div>
        </div>

         CASE 2: List of reviewers
         ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->

        <!-- Empty list -->

<script>
  async function confirmDelete() {
    const idInput = document.getElementById('deleteId');
    const id = idInput.value;
    if (!id) {
      alert('Please enter an Inventory ID.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Step 1: Check if exists by calling the detail endpoint
      // We use the absolute path or relative to context
      const response = await fetch('/store-owner/inventory/' + id, { method: 'GET' });
      
      if (response.ok && !response.url.includes('?apiError=')) {
        // Step 2: If found, ask for confirmation
        if (confirm('Item found! Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY delete record #' + id + '?')) {
          document.getElementById('deleteForm').submit();
        }
      } else {
        // Step 3: If not found (or redirected to error)
        alert('Item doesn\'t exist. No action taken.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Check failed:', error);
      alert('Unable to verify item. Please try again.');
    }
  }

  // Auto-hide success message after 5 seconds
  const alertBox = document.getElementById('successAlert');
  if (alertBox) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      alertBox.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
      alertBox.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => alertBox.remove(), 500);
    }, 5000);
  }
</script>

    containing userId, username, and roleName as claims. Token expiry is configurable.
    Include this token as: Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt; in all subsequent protected requests.
  </div>
  <div class="card" style="padding:0;margin-bottom:16px;">
    <table class="data-table">

        <tr><td>token</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>JWT Bearer token</td></tr>
        <tr><td>tokenType</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Always "Bearer"</td></tr>
        <tr><td>userId</td><td class="mono">Integer</td><td>Logged-in user's ID</td></tr>
        <tr><td>userName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Username</td></tr>
        <tr><td>firstName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>First name</td></tr>
        <tr><td>lastName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Last name</td></tr>
        <tr><td>roleName</td><td class="mono">String</td><td>Assigned role</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div class="alert alert-info">
